amends: NP-HALL-PARAMETRIC-ENVELOPE v1 (prereg_v1.json 3275f85752fae258e4e4124cbe43d8756e8dfede70f560f8b2e7d66a40164b4d, lock prereg_lock_v1.json 25ecfa880e9d115800821bcb2dfe5bab333323b214c3668a6fb8a9a54d53ebd3); v1 and its case file, launch manifest and driver are not edited

supersedes.why: coordinator naming under A9.34: the AIR-family addition to NP-HALL-PARAMETRIC-ENVELOPE is addendum A1 (prereg_addendum_a1_air_family*); A2 is reserved for the closure-integration lane and A3 for the Hall-run numerics-adequacy check. Superseded before any AIR run: no AIR launch manifest and no AIR record exists under addendum 01
supersedes.carried_over: every rule of addendum 01 is carried over verbatim except the fields listed in changes_vs_addendum_01
supersedes.preserved: addendum_01_air_family.json, ADDENDUM_01_AIR_FAMILY.md and addendum_01_lock.json stay in the repository unchanged as history; no tool reads them after this addendum

changes_vs_addendum_01: id, addendum name and lock file name (A1)
governing_records: adds A9.34 and NP-HALL-CHEM-AIR addendum 03 (and its lock); records the superseded addendum 01
launch_gate: adds the bounded launch path LP-BOUNDED for the registered bounding variant set BV-AIR-LL (NP-HALL-CHEM-AIR addendum 03); LP-COMPLETE is the addendum 01 gate unchanged
record_fields_added and record_rejection: chemistry_mode, chemistry_bound_set, chemistry_bound_member, chemistry_bound_label
hall_specific_closure_air.bounded_variant_outcome and classification_effect.bounded_variant: what a BV-AIR-LL envelope can and cannot establish
the case file header (addendum id, addendum and lock sha256, status text); every case and every case_sha256 is unchanged
drafted_by: agent session; coordinator-directed naming and A9.34 M1 bounded treatment; not reviewed by the owner; nothing here is an owner decision
mandate: A9.33 Q2 (Hall O / O2 chemistry contract; AIR Hall NOT_EVALUATED until admitted) on A9.32 (two-layer closure classification); v1 change_control: a new, dated addendum registered before the runs it governs; A9.34 M1 exit item 'Hall AIR chemistry available or explicitly bounded' (delivered EXPLICITLY_BOUNDED, NP-HALL-CHEM-AIR addendum 03)
registered_before: any AIR envelope run and any AIR launch manifest. No Hall run of any O-bearing feed exists. The AIR reaction set is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (hallthruster_bridge/propellants_air/AIR_PINNED.toml abep-air-0.7); AIR runs may start only through LP-BOUNDED, as the labelled bounding variant BV-AIR-LL.
what_changes: adds a third family AIR (supply mode AIR_PRIMARY) to the envelope; XE and N2_PROXY, their 4536 cases, the v1 driver and launch manifest stay exactly as committed

replaces, for AIR_PRIMARY layer (a), the v1 reason AIR_HALL_O_O2_CHEMISTRY_NOT_ADMITTED by an evaluation rule that applies only once the AIR reaction set is COMPLETE_FOR_PARAMETRIC_ENVELOPE; until then AIR layer (a) stays NOT_EVALUATED with that same reason
N2_PROXY keeps no classification role (v1 families[1]); it is neither a bound nor a proxy for AIR

adds, for the AIR family only, a bounded launch path: while the AIR set is not admitted, the registered one-sided bounding variant set BV-AIR-LL may run as labelled information; it never replaces the admission rule and never yields a closure or a non-closure
what_does_not_change: credible Hall transport set EMPTY; HallMap admission and the hall_ensemble logic; layer (b) Hall NOT_EVALUATED
the HallThruster.jl pin (v0.23.1, bfb3019f), bridge_lib.jl, abep-n2n-0.11, the P5-N2 records
the v1 run-status rule for XE and N2_PROXY, the v1 B(z) family (SOURCED_SURROGATE, asymmetric rule), numerics, transport set and non-Hall inputs
the NP-HALL-CHEM-AIR v1 admission rule AD-HA-01..07 and AIR_PINNED.toml status INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE; LP-BOUNDED admits nothing

family.chemistry: the Hall AIR reaction set of NP-HALL-CHEM-AIR (label and status in hallthruster_bridge/propellants_air/AIR_PINNED.toml), configuration propellants_air/air_nominal.toml (nominal members), rate_dir propellants_air; one chemistry configuration, so no chemistry robustness is claimed (label CHEMISTRY_NOMINAL_ONLY; evidence condition EC-CHEM)
family.run_function: hallthruster_bridge/air_bridge_lib.jl run_case_air (NI-01 per-species Propellants; vacuum; bridge helpers unchanged)
family.composition: the four CE-AIR hull corners CP-YLO-REC, CP-YLO-DIS, CP-YHI-REC, CP-YHI-DIS (NP-HALL-CHEM-AIR prereg composition.hall_composition_points), recomputed by the Rust generator from the frozen design-state set and required to equal the preregistered values exactly; label COMPOSITION_HULL_CORNERS_NOT_INTERIOR_BOUNDS
family.inlet: NI-01 (NP-HALL-CHEM-AIR addendum 01): 500 K, velocity 150 x sqrt(M_N2 / M_s), solver masses; label NEUTRAL_INLET_EQUAL_T_SCALED_FROM_V1_DEFAULT

case_grid.rule: every v1 N2_PROXY row (file order; geometry, B(z) registration, B_peak, V_d, delivered mass flow, transport candidate and numerics copied unchanged from the frozen v1 case file) x the four composition corners (corner order above); the delivered mass flow is split by the corner's mass fractions (NI-01)
case_grid.generator: Rust (crates/abep-julia-bridge/src/air_cases.rs; abep-air-cases generate / check), byte-reproducible, case_sha256 = the v1 canonical case hash

LP-COMPLETE.rule: the AIR launch manifest is generated only when abep_chem::hall_air::AirSet::admission() is Ok (AIR_PINNED.toml status COMPLETE_FOR_PARAMETRIC_ENVELOPE, no tier-1 gap, no blocking item); generation refuses with INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (or MODEL_ERROR for NOT_REPRESENTABLE_IN_PINNED_SOLVER) otherwise

LP-BOUNDED.rule: while abep_chem::hall_air::AirSet::admission() refuses (INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE or MODEL_ERROR), the AIR launch manifest may be generated for the registered bounding variant set BV-AIR-LL (NP-HALL-CHEM-AIR addendum 03) only if: (1) addendum 03 and its lock verify against the sha256 pinned here; (2) AIR_PINNED.toml has label abep-air-0.7 and the sha256 pinned by addendum 03 (so every table pin is the registered one); (3) rate_validity.toml has the addendum 03 sha256; (4) the configuration this case file runs (propellants_air/air_nominal.toml) is member BV-AIR-LL-NOM with the addendum 03 sha256; (5) AirSet::load passes (every pinned table and configuration verifies, no unlisted file, validity coverage). Any mismatch refuses with MODEL_ERROR
LP-BOUNDED.member_BV-AIR-LL-ALT: not run under A1 (this case file runs the nominal configuration only; CHEMISTRY_NOMINAL_ONLY); running it needs a new addendum with its own case file
LP-BOUNDED.stated_direction: addendum 03 D-1 holds for the chemistry inputs at a fixed plasma state only; D-2 and D-3: no direction is claimed for any Hall observable, so a BV-AIR-LL result is neither an upper nor a lower bound on thrust, discharge current or power
LP-BOUNDED.superseded_when: the AIR set is admitted (LP-COMPLETE opens): BV-AIR-LL records are then superseded, never relabelled and never mixed with COMPLETE records

launch_gate.pins_at_launch: case file sha256, driver sha256, air_bridge_lib.jl and bridge_lib.jl sha256, AIR_PINNED.toml sha256 and label, air_nominal.toml sha256, propellants_air/rate_validity.toml sha256 and every configured rate file's sha256; plus chemistry_mode, and for LP-BOUNDED the addendum 03 and lock sha256, the set id, member and label
launch_gate.chemistry_changes: a chemistry change after launch is a new label and a new launch manifest; records of two labels are never mixed in one envelope; records of the two chemistry modes are never mixed in one envelope
launch_gate.today: LP-COMPLETE REFUSED (the AIR reaction set is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE). LP-BOUNDED is available: BV-AIR-LL-NOM, label BOUNDED_ONE_SIDED_LOWER_ELECTRON_IMPACT_LOSS_NOT_COMPLETE

run_status_rule.basis: v1 run_status_rule, with the AIR chemistry checks of NP-HALL-CHEM-AIR (DOM-AIR-01, DOM-AIR-02)

statuses.OUT_OF_DOMAIN: chemistry_unresolved_rate_files non-empty, any chemistry_per_reaction extrapolated_fraction null or > 1e-12 (DOM-AIR-01), or audit_domain_fraction_max null or > 1e-12 (DOM-AIR-02); evaluated independently of sustainment

run_status_rule.record_rejection: as v1, plus: a record whose air_label, air_pinned_sha256 or air_config_sha256 differs from the AIR launch manifest makes the AIR ingestion MODEL_ERROR; and a record whose chemistry_mode, chemistry_bound_set, chemistry_bound_member or chemistry_bound_label differs from the AIR launch manifest, or an envelope mixing chemistry modes, makes the AIR ingestion MODEL_ERROR

hall_specific_closure_air.point_tests: T12 and T25 exactly as v1 (thrust_N >= HC-01 / HC-02 and P_bus_fav < HC-03; PASS only)
hall_specific_closure_air.composition_rule: the composition is not a controllable variable: a test closes on a hardware configuration (geometry, bz_shape) only if, for EVERY composition corner, some PASS point of that hardware (any B_peak, V_d, mdot, transport candidate) passes it; T12 and T25 must both close on the same hardware (v1 hardware_consistency)

constraint_status.CLOSES_IN_ENVELOPE: the composition rule holds for T12 and T25 on one hardware configuration
constraint_status.NOT_DETERMINABLE_IN_ENVELOPE: otherwise, with blockers: HALL_NON_CLOSING_UNDER_AIR_ENVELOPE (no closure among evaluated physics), the OUT_OF_DOMAIN / NUMERICAL_FAILURE counts, H1_BZ_NOT_REGISTERED, AIR_COMPOSITION_NOT_REGISTERED, AIR_CHEMISTRY_NOMINAL_ONLY
constraint_status.NOT_EVALUATED: no AIR envelope ingested, or the AIR reaction set not admitted (AIR_HALL_O_O2_CHEMISTRY_NOT_ADMITTED)

hall_specific_closure_air.non_closure: never eligible for PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING in this addendum: the B(z) family is a surrogate (v1 bz_family), the composition corners do not bound interior compositions, and only the nominal chemistry members run; a demonstrated AIR non-closure is recorded as HALL_NON_CLOSING_UNDER_AIR_ENVELOPE (A9.31 sec. 21 category DESIGN_VARIABLE_LIMIT / MODEL_DOMAIN_LIMIT) and the classification stays NOT_DETERMINABLE
hall_specific_closure_air.margins_and_robustness: as v1 per composition corner; ROBUST_UNDER_TRANSPORT_SET only if all nine candidates close at every corner

bounded_variant_outcome.applies: every AIR envelope ingested under LP-BOUNDED
bounded_variant_outcome.rule: the point tests and the composition rule are evaluated exactly as above and reported as labelled information only: BOUNDED_INFORMATION_CLOSES_AT_ALL_CORNERS (the composition rule holds for T12 and T25 on one hardware configuration) or BOUNDED_INFORMATION_NO_CLOSURE_FOUND; every derived quantity carries the label BOUNDED_ONE_SIDED_LOWER_ELECTRON_IMPACT_LOSS_NOT_COMPLETE
bounded_variant_outcome.constraint_status: NOT_DETERMINABLE_IN_ENVELOPE with blocker AIR_CHEMISTRY_BOUNDED_NOT_COMPLETE (plus the other blockers above that apply), whatever the bounded information says: CLOSES_IN_ENVELOPE is reachable only from an LP-COMPLETE envelope
bounded_variant_outcome.never: never SELECT_WITH_EVIDENCE_CONDITIONS (closure) and never PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING (non-closure) on its own; never a bound on a Hall observable (addendum 03 D-3)

state_applicability.rule: AIR Hall results are state-independent vacuum runs; a required state inherits the AIR Hall constraint status unless it is under an unresolved species bound of NP-HALL-CHEM-AIR
state_applicability.SB-He: states with free-stream x_He > 0.01 (14 ECSS_LT_LOW states): AIR Hall NOT_EVALUATED (MATERIALITY_BOUND_REQUIRED_HE) until SB-He is resolved
state_applicability.SB-Ar: states with free-stream x_Ar > 0.01 (6 ECSS_ST_HIGH states): AIR Hall NOT_EVALUATED (MATERIALITY_BOUND_REQUIRED_AR) until SB-Ar is resolved
state_applicability.SB-NO: must be resolved for admission (AD-HA-05); no state-resolved treatment

classification_effect.procedure: v1 classification_rule C0..C4 unchanged in structure; AIR_PRIMARY layer (a) Hall constraints HALL_T12_AT_PBUS and HALL_T25_CAPABILITY are evaluated by hall_specific_closure_air instead of NOT_EVALUATED once an AIR envelope of an admitted label is ingested
classification_effect.C2: cannot be reached through the AIR family (non_closure rule); it can still be reached through an eligible evaluated non-Hall non-closure as in v1
C3_additional_evidence_conditions: EC-COMP: the delivered composition is registered for each required state, lies inside the CE-AIR hull (including any species-selective collection, ICD G-02) and the Hall closes at it
EC-CHEM: the closure holds under the registered chemistry variants (AIR-ALT members and every uncertainty variant of the admitted set), and the SONG2026 version-of-record status of the admission
EC-INLET: the registered delivered feed temperature and velocity replace NI-01 and the closure holds
classification_effect.today: AIR layer (a) NOT_EVALUATED (AIR_HALL_O_O2_CHEMISTRY_NOT_ADMITTED) until an AIR envelope is ingested; after an LP-BOUNDED envelope: NOT_DETERMINABLE (AIR_CHEMISTRY_BOUNDED_NOT_COMPLETE); the A9.32 classification stays NOT_DETERMINABLE
classification_effect.bounded_variant: an LP-BOUNDED envelope leaves AIR_PRIMARY layer (a) HALL_T12_AT_PBUS and HALL_T25_CAPABILITY NOT_DETERMINABLE (blocker AIR_CHEMISTRY_BOUNDED_NOT_COMPLETE); C3 and C2 cannot be reached through it; it is reported with its label as M1 'explicitly bounded' information (A9.34)

execution.order: only after the launch gate opens (LP-COMPLETE, or LP-BOUNDED as BV-AIR-LL-NOM); family AIR runs as its own shard set and frozen raw file (never mixed with XE / N2_PROXY records, never mixing chemistry modes); threads / BLAS pinned to 1; per-record provenance as v1 plus the AIR pins and the chemistry mode; staging by composition corner (driver corner argument) is allowed and changes no rule (OQ-HPE-AIR-01 open)
execution.driver: docs/rust_migration/new_physics/NP-HALL-PARAMETRIC-ENVELOPE/driver/h1_envelope_air_driver.jl (refuses to run without an AIR launch manifest whose pins match); it reads prereg_addendum_a1_air_family_lock.json
execution.runtime_estimate: 9072 runs; four neutral and five ion species with 34 reactions per run (air_nominal.toml at abep-air-0.7) against two neutrals, three ions and 29 reactions for N2_PROXY: assumed no cheaper than the v1 N2_PROXY estimate (~2 min mean), i.e. of order 300 CPU-h or more; an estimate, not a measurement (owner question OQ-HPE-AIR-01)
execution.ingestion: the Rust ingestion of AIR records and their classification in abep-assess are implemented with the launch gate's first opening; they follow this addendum literally, including bounded_variant_outcome

open_owner_questions.question: AIR envelope cost (~9072 runs, extrapolated >= 300 CPU-h): accept the full grid once the chemistry is admitted, stage it by composition corner, or register a reduced grid in a new addendum? A reduced grid can only miss closures (non-closure is never eligible here).

Composition as an uncontrolled variable (closure must hold at every corner): accept (drafted), or rule that the dissociation degree is a gas-path design choice (existence over f_O), which would need a new addendum and a registered gas-path design basis?

change_control: any change after this lock is a new, dated addendum registered before the runs it governs; results seen under this addendum cannot justify changing it
